hopper-company-queries-i: WITH RECURSIVE year_cte(year, max_year) AS ( SELECT MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', join_date) AS INTEGER)), MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', join_date) AS INTEGER)) FROM Drivers UNION ALL SELECT year + 1, max_year FROM year_cte WHERE year < max_year ), year_month_cte(year, month, max_month) AS ( SELECT year, 1, 12 FROM year_cte UNION ALL SELECT year, month + 1, max_month FROM year_month_cte WHERE month < max_month ), drivers_count_cte AS ( SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', d.join_date) AS INTEGER) AS year, CAST(strftime('%m', d.join_date) AS INTEGER) AS month, COUNT(d.driver_id) AS drivers_count FROM Drivers d GROUP BY substr(d.join_date, 1, 7) ), rides_count_cte AS ( SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', r.requested_at) AS INTEGER) AS year, CAST(strftime('%m', r.requested_at) AS INTEGER) AS month, COUNT(a.ride_id) AS accepted_rides FROM Rides r LEFT JOIN AcceptedRides a ON r.ride_id = a.ride_id GROUP BY substr(r.requested_at, 1, 7) ) SELECT t1.month, COALESCE(SUM(t2.drivers_count) OVER (ORDER BY t1.year, t1.month), 0) AS active_drivers, COALESCE(t3.accepted_rides, 0) AS accepted_rides FROM year_month_cte t1 LEFT JOIN drivers_count_cte t2 ON t1.year = t2.year AND t1.month = t2.month LEFT JOIN rides_count_cte t3 ON t1.year = t3.year AND t1.month = t3.month WHERE t1.year = 2020;
hopper-company-queries-ii: WITH RECURSIVE year_cte(year, max_year) AS ( SELECT MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', join_date) AS INTEGER)), MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', join_date) AS INTEGER)) FROM Drivers UNION ALL SELECT year + 1, max_year FROM year_cte WHERE year < max_year ), year_month_cte(year, month, max_month) AS ( SELECT year, 1, 12 FROM year_cte UNION ALL SELECT year, month + 1, max_month FROM year_month_cte WHERE month < max_month ), drivers_count_cte AS ( SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', d.join_date) AS INTEGER) AS year, CAST(strftime('%m', d.join_date) AS INTEGER) AS month, COUNT(d.driver_id) AS drivers_count FROM Drivers d GROUP BY substr(d.join_date, 1, 7) ), working_drivers_count_cte AS ( SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', r.requested_at) AS INTEGER) AS year, CAST(strftime('%m', r.requested_at) AS INTEGER) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT a.driver_id) AS working_drivers FROM Rides r LEFT JOIN AcceptedRides a ON r.ride_id = a.ride_id GROUP BY substr(r.requested_at, 1, 7) ) SELECT t1.month, ROUND(COALESCE(1.0 * t3.working_drivers / NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(t2.drivers_count) OVER (ORDER BY t1.year, t1.month), 0), 0), 0) * 100, 2) AS working_percentage FROM year_month_cte t1 LEFT JOIN drivers_count_cte t2 ON t1.year = t2.year AND t1.month = t2.month LEFT JOIN working_drivers_count_cte t3 ON t1.year = t3.year AND t1.month = t3.month WHERE t1.year = 2020;
hopper-company-queries-iii: WITH RECURSIVE year_cte(year, max_year) AS ( SELECT MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', join_date) AS INTEGER)), MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', join_date) AS INTEGER)) FROM Drivers UNION ALL SELECT year + 1, max_year FROM year_cte WHERE year < max_year ), year_month_cte(year, month, max_month) AS ( SELECT year, 1, 12 FROM year_cte UNION ALL SELECT year, month + 1, max_month FROM year_month_cte WHERE month < max_month ), total_per_month_cte AS ( SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', r.requested_at) AS INTEGER) AS year, CAST(strftime('%m', r.requested_at) AS INTEGER) AS month, SUM(a.ride_distance) AS monthly_distance, SUM(a.ride_duration) AS monthly_duration FROM Rides r LEFT JOIN AcceptedRides a ON r.ride_id = a.ride_id GROUP BY substr(r.requested_at, 1, 7) ) SELECT t1.month, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(t2.monthly_distance) OVER (ORDER BY t1.year, t1.month ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING), 0) / 3.0, 2) AS average_ride_distance, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(t2.monthly_duration) OVER (ORDER BY t1.year, t1.month ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING), 0) / 3.0, 2) AS average_ride_duration FROM year_month_cte t1 LEFT JOIN total_per_month_cte t2 ON t1.year = t2.year AND t1.month = t2.month WHERE t1.year = 2020 AND t1.month <= 10;
league-statistics: WITH match_score_cte AS ( SELECT *, CASE WHEN home_team_goals > away_team_goals THEN 3 WHEN home_team_goals = away_team_goals THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS home_score, CASE WHEN home_team_goals < away_team_goals THEN 3 WHEN home_team_goals = away_team_goals THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS away_score FROM Matches ), team_score_cte AS ( SELECT home_team_id AS team_id, home_score AS score, home_team_goals AS goal_for, away_team_goals AS goal_against FROM match_score_cte UNION ALL SELECT away_team_id, away_score, away_team_goals, home_team_goals FROM match_score_cte ) SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS matches_played, SUM(s.score) AS points, SUM(s.goal_for) AS goal_for, SUM(s.goal_against) AS goal_against, SUM(s.goal_for) - SUM(s.goal_against) AS goal_diff FROM team_score_cte s JOIN Teams t ON s.team_id = t.team_id GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name ORDER BY points DESC, t.team_name, goal_diff DESC, goal_for DESC, goal_against;
confirmation-rate: WITH rate_cte AS ( SELECT user_id, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN action = 'confirmed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS confirmation_rate FROM Confirmations GROUP BY user_id ) SELECT s.user_id, COALESCE(r.confirmation_rate, 0) AS confirmation_rate FROM Signups s LEFT JOIN rate_cte r ON s.user_id = r.user_id;
users-that-actively-request-confirmation: SELECT DISTINCT c1.user_id FROM Confirmations c1 JOIN Confirmations c2 ON c1.user_id = c2.user_id WHERE c1.time_stamp < c2.time_stamp AND (julianday(c2.time_stamp) - julianday(c1.time_stamp)) * 86400 <= 86400;
the-number-of-seniors-and-juniors-to-joi: WITH senior_cte AS ( SELECT employee_id, salary_accu FROM ( SELECT employee_id, SUM(salary) OVER (ORDER BY salary, employee_id) AS salary_accu FROM Candidates WHERE experience = 'Senior' ) a WHERE salary_accu <= 70000 ), senior_max_cte AS ( SELECT COALESCE(MAX(salary_accu), 0) AS salary FROM senior_cte ), junior_cte AS ( SELECT employee_id FROM ( SELECT employee_id, SUM(salary) OVER (ORDER BY salary, employee_id) AS salary_accu FROM Candidates WHERE experience = 'Junior' ) a WHERE salary_accu + (SELECT salary FROM senior_max_cte) <= 70000 ) SELECT 'Senior' AS experience, COUNT(*) AS accepted_candidates FROM senior_cte UNION ALL SELECT 'Junior' AS experience, COUNT(*) AS accepted_candidates FROM junior_cte;

WITH senior_cte AS ( SELECT employee_id, salary_accu FROM ( SELECT employee_id, SUM(salary) OVER (ORDER BY salary, employee_id) AS salary_accu FROM Candidates WHERE experience = 'Senior' ) a WHERE salary_accu <= 70000 ), senior_max_cte AS ( SELECT COALESCE(MAX(salary_accu), 0) AS salary FROM senior_cte ), junior_cte AS ( SELECT employee_id FROM ( SELECT employee_id, SUM(salary) OVER (ORDER BY salary, employee_id) AS salary_accu FROM Candidates WHERE experience = 'Junior' ) a WHERE salary_accu + (SELECT salary FROM senior_max_cte) <= 70000 ) SELECT employee_id FROM senior_cte UNION ALL SELECT employee_id FROM junior_cte;
count-the-number-of-experiments: WITH platforms_cte(platform) AS ( SELECT 'IOS' UNION ALL SELECT 'Android' UNION ALL SELECT 'Web' ), experiment_names_cte(experiment_name) AS ( SELECT 'Programming' UNION ALL SELECT 'Sports' UNION ALL SELECT 'Reading' ), platforms_and_experiments_cte AS ( SELECT p.platform, e.experiment_name FROM platforms_cte p CROSS JOIN experiment_names_cte e ) SELECT a.platform, a.experiment_name, COUNT(b.platform) AS num_experiments FROM platforms_and_experiments_cte a LEFT JOIN Experiments b ON a.platform = b.platform AND a.experiment_name = b.experiment_name GROUP BY a.platform, a.experiment_name;
account-balance: SELECT account_id, day, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Deposit' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY day) AS balance FROM Transactions;
the-airport-with-the-most-traffic: WITH flight_counts_cte AS ( SELECT airport_id, SUM(flights_count) AS flights_count FROM ( SELECT departure_airport AS airport_id, flights_count FROM Flights UNION ALL SELECT arrival_airport, flights_count FROM Flights ) a GROUP BY airport_id ) SELECT a.airport_id FROM flight_counts_cte a JOIN (SELECT MAX(flights_count) AS max_flights_count FROM flight_counts_cte) c ON a.flights_count = c.max_flights_count;
the-number-of-passengers-in-each-bus-ii: WITH ordered_buses AS ( SELECT bus_id, arrival_time, capacity, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Passengers p WHERE p.arrival_time <= b.arrival_time) AS cum, LAG((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Passengers p WHERE p.arrival_time <= b.arrival_time), 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY arrival_time) AS prev_cum FROM Buses b ) SELECT bus_id, MIN(capacity, cum - prev_cum) AS passengers_cnt FROM ordered_buses ORDER BY bus_id;
finding-the-topic-of-each-post: SELECT p.post_id, COALESCE(( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(topic_id, ',') FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT k.topic_id FROM Keywords k WHERE (' ' || LOWER(p.content) || ' ') LIKE ('% ' || LOWER(k.word) || ' %') ORDER BY k.topic_id ) ), 'Ambiguous!') AS topic FROM Posts p;
longest-winning-streak: WITH player_match_seq_cte AS ( SELECT player_id, match_day, result, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_day) AS seq FROM Matches ), player_match_group_id_cte AS ( SELECT player_id, seq - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_day) AS group_id FROM player_match_seq_cte WHERE result = 'Win' ), player_match_group_cte AS ( SELECT player_id, group_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM player_match_group_id_cte GROUP BY player_id, group_id ) SELECT a.player_id, COALESCE(MAX(b.cnt), 0) AS longest_streak FROM (SELECT DISTINCT player_id FROM Matches) a LEFT JOIN player_match_group_cte b ON a.player_id = b.player_id GROUP BY a.player_id;
dynamic-unpivoting-of-a-table: SELECT product_id, 'LC_Store' AS store, LC_Store AS price FROM Products WHERE LC_Store IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT product_id, 'Nozama', Nozama FROM Products WHERE Nozama IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT product_id, 'Shop', Shop FROM Products WHERE Shop IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT product_id, 'Souq', Souq FROM Products WHERE Souq IS NOT NULL;
tasks-count-in-the-weekend: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%w', submit_date) AS INTEGER) IN (0, 6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%w', submit_date) AS INTEGER) NOT IN (0, 6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS working_cnt FROM Tasks;
the-number-of-users-that-are-eligible-fo: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS user_cnt FROM Purchases WHERE time_stamp BETWEEN '2022-03-08' AND '2022-03-20' AND amount >= 1000;
arrange-table-by-gender: WITH genders_cte AS ( SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY gender ORDER BY user_id) AS rnk1, CASE gender WHEN 'female' THEN 1 WHEN 'other' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS rnk2 FROM Genders ) SELECT user_id, gender FROM genders_cte ORDER BY rnk1, rnk2;
change-null-values-in-a-table-to-the-pre: WITH cte AS ( SELECT id, drink, SUM(CASE WHEN drink IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS grp FROM CoffeeShop ) SELECT id, MAX(drink) OVER (PARTITION BY grp ORDER BY id) AS drink FROM cte ORDER BY id;
employees-with-deductions: SELECT e.employee_id FROM Employees e LEFT JOIN Logs l ON e.employee_id = l.employee_id GROUP BY e.employee_id HAVING COALESCE(SUM(CEIL((strftime('%s', l.out_time) - strftime('%s', l.in_time)) / 60.0) / 60.0), 0) < MAX(e.needed_hours);
form-a-chemical-bond: WITH metal_cte AS (SELECT symbol FROM Elements WHERE type = 'Metal'), nonmetal_cte AS (SELECT symbol FROM Elements WHERE type = 'Nonmetal') SELECT m.symbol AS metal, n.symbol AS nonmetal FROM metal_cte m CROSS JOIN nonmetal_cte n;
concatenate-the-name-and-the-profession: SELECT person_id, name || '(' || substr(profession, 1, 1) || ')' AS name FROM Person ORDER BY person_id DESC;
count-artist-occurrences-on-spotify-rank: SELECT artist, COUNT(*) AS occurrences FROM Spotify GROUP BY artist ORDER BY occurrences DESC, artist;
find-active-users: WITH active_users_cte AS ( SELECT user_id, CASE WHEN CAST(julianday(created_at) - julianday(LAG(created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY created_at)) AS INTEGER) <= 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS active FROM Users ) SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM active_users_cte WHERE active = 1;
consecutive-transactions-with-increasing: WITH date_group_cte AS ( SELECT *, CAST(julianday(transaction_date) AS INTEGER) - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY transaction_date) AS date_group FROM Transactions ), increasing_date_group_cte AS ( SELECT *, CASE WHEN amount <= LAG(amount, 1, amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, date_group ORDER BY transaction_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS start FROM date_group_cte ), group_cte AS ( SELECT *, SUM(start) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY transaction_date) AS group_id FROM increasing_date_group_cte ) SELECT customer_id, MIN(transaction_date) AS consecutive_start, MAX(transaction_date) AS consecutive_end FROM group_cte GROUP BY customer_id, group_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3;
customers-with-maximum-number-of-transac: WITH group_cte AS ( SELECT customer_id, CAST(julianday(transaction_date) - julianday(MIN(transaction_date) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id)) AS INTEGER) + 1 - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY transaction_date) AS diff FROM Transactions ), cnt_cte AS ( SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM group_cte GROUP BY customer_id, diff ) SELECT customer_id FROM cnt_cte WHERE cnt = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM cnt_cte) ORDER BY customer_id;
flight-occupancy-and-waitlist-analysis: SELECT a.flight_id, MIN(COUNT(b.passenger_id), a.capacity) AS booked_cnt, MAX(COUNT(b.passenger_id) - a.capacity, 0) AS waitlist_cnt FROM Flights a LEFT JOIN Passengers b ON a.flight_id = b.flight_id GROUP BY a.flight_id, a.capacity ORDER BY a.flight_id;
rolling-average-steps: WITH avg_cte AS ( SELECT s1.user_id, s1.steps_date, COUNT(s2.steps_date) AS cnt, ROUND(AVG(s2.steps_count), 2) AS rolling_average FROM Steps s1 JOIN Steps s2 ON s1.user_id = s2.user_id AND julianday(s1.steps_date) - julianday(s2.steps_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 2 GROUP BY s1.user_id, s1.steps_date ) SELECT user_id, steps_date, rolling_average FROM avg_cte WHERE cnt = 3 ORDER BY user_id, steps_date;
find-peak-calling-hours-for-each-city: WITH call_by_hour_cte AS ( SELECT city, CAST(strftime('%H', call_time) AS INTEGER) AS calling_hour, COUNT(*) AS number_of_calls FROM Calls GROUP BY city, calling_hour ), rank_calling_hour_cte AS ( SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY number_of_calls DESC) AS rnk FROM call_by_hour_cte ) SELECT city, calling_hour AS peak_calling_hour, number_of_calls FROM rank_calling_hour_cte WHERE rnk = 1 ORDER BY number_of_calls DESC, city DESC;
top-three-wineries: WITH rank_cte AS ( SELECT country, winery, SUM(points) AS total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY SUM(points) DESC, winery) AS rnk FROM Wineries GROUP BY country, winery ) SELECT country, MAX(CASE WHEN rnk = 1 THEN winery || ' (' || total || ')' END) AS top_winery, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rnk = 2 THEN winery || ' (' || total || ')' END), 'No second winery') AS second_winery, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rnk = 3 THEN winery || ' (' || total || ')' END), 'No third winery') AS third_winery FROM rank_cte WHERE rnk <= 3 GROUP BY country ORDER BY country;
friday-purchases-ii: WITH date_cte(week_of_month, purchase_date) AS ( SELECT 1, '2023-11-03' UNION ALL SELECT 2, '2023-11-10' UNION ALL SELECT 3, '2023-11-17' UNION ALL SELECT 4, '2023-11-24' ) SELECT a.week_of_month, a.purchase_date, COALESCE(SUM(b.amount_spend), 0) AS total_amount FROM date_cte a LEFT JOIN Purchases b ON a.purchase_date = b.purchase_date GROUP BY a.week_of_month, a.purchase_date ORDER BY a.week_of_month;
viewers-turned-streamers: WITH sessions_cte AS ( SELECT user_id, session_type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY session_start) AS rnk, SUM(CASE WHEN session_type = 'Streamer' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id) AS sessions_count FROM Sessions ) SELECT user_id, sessions_count FROM sessions_cte WHERE rnk = 1 AND session_type = 'Viewer' AND sessions_count > 0 ORDER BY sessions_count DESC;
friday-purchases-i: SELECT CAST((CAST(strftime('%d', purchase_date) AS INTEGER) - 1) / 7 + 1 AS INTEGER) AS week_of_month, purchase_date, SUM(amount_spend) AS total_amount FROM Purchases WHERE CAST(strftime('%w', purchase_date) AS INTEGER) = 5 GROUP BY purchase_date ORDER BY week_of_month;
maximize-items: WITH prime_cte AS ( SELECT item_type, CAST(FLOOR(500000.0 / SUM(square_footage)) AS INTEGER) * COUNT(*) AS item_count, CAST(FLOOR(500000.0 / SUM(square_footage)) AS INTEGER) * SUM(square_footage) AS total FROM Inventory WHERE item_type = 'prime_eligible' ), not_prime_cte AS ( SELECT item_type, CAST(FLOOR((500000.0 - (SELECT total FROM prime_cte)) / SUM(square_footage)) AS INTEGER) * COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM Inventory WHERE item_type = 'not_prime' ) SELECT item_type, item_count FROM prime_cte UNION ALL SELECT item_type, item_count FROM not_prime_cte ORDER BY item_count DESC;
snaps-analysis: SELECT a2.age_bucket, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN a1.activity_type = 'send' THEN time_spent ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(time_spent), 2) AS send_perc, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN a1.activity_type = 'open' THEN time_spent ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(time_spent), 2) AS open_perc FROM Activities a1 LEFT JOIN Age a2 ON a1.user_id = a2.user_id GROUP BY a2.age_bucket;
find-trending-hashtags: SELECT '#' || SUBSTR(tweet, INSTR(tweet, '#') + 1, CASE WHEN INSTR(SUBSTR(tweet, INSTR(tweet, '#') + 1), ' ') > 0 THEN INSTR(SUBSTR(tweet, INSTR(tweet, '#') + 1), ' ') - 1 ELSE LENGTH(SUBSTR(tweet, INSTR(tweet, '#') + 1)) END) AS hashtag, COUNT(*) AS hashtag_count FROM Tweets WHERE tweet_date BETWEEN '2024-02-01' AND '2024-02-29' AND INSTR(tweet, '#') > 0 GROUP BY hashtag ORDER BY hashtag_count DESC, hashtag DESC LIMIT 3;
find-all-unique-email-domains: SELECT SUBSTR(email, INSTR(email, '@') + 1) AS email_domain, COUNT(*) AS count FROM Emails WHERE email LIKE '%.com' GROUP BY email_domain ORDER BY email_domain;
user-activities-within-time-bounds: WITH diff_cte AS ( SELECT *, CAST((strftime('%s', LEAD(session_start) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, session_type ORDER BY session_start)) - strftime('%s', session_end)) / 3600.0 AS INTEGER) AS diff FROM Sessions ) SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM diff_cte WHERE diff <= 12 ORDER BY user_id;
calculate-trapping-rain-water: WITH left_right_max_cte AS ( SELECT *, MAX(height) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS left_max, MAX(height) OVER (ORDER BY id DESC) AS right_max FROM Heights ) SELECT SUM(MIN(left_max, right_max) - height) AS total_trapped_water FROM left_right_max_cte;
find-trending-hashtags-ii: WITH RECURSIVE hashtag_cte(hashtag, remain, tweet_date) AS ( SELECT '#' || SUBSTR(tweet, INSTR(tweet, '#') + 1, CASE WHEN INSTR(SUBSTR(tweet, INSTR(tweet, '#') + 1), ' ') > 0 THEN INSTR(SUBSTR(tweet, INSTR(tweet, '#') + 1), ' ') - 1 ELSE LENGTH(SUBSTR(tweet, INSTR(tweet, '#') + 1)) END), CASE WHEN INSTR(SUBSTR(tweet, INSTR(tweet, '#') + 1), ' ') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(tweet, INSTR(tweet, '#') + 1 + INSTR(SUBSTR(tweet, INSTR(tweet, '#') + 1), ' ')) ELSE '' END, tweet_date FROM Tweets WHERE INSTR(tweet, '#') > 0 UNION ALL SELECT '#' || SUBSTR(remain, INSTR(remain, '#') + 1, CASE WHEN INSTR(SUBSTR(remain, INSTR(remain, '#') + 1), ' ') > 0 THEN INSTR(SUBSTR(remain, INSTR(remain, '#') + 1), ' ') - 1 ELSE LENGTH(SUBSTR(remain, INSTR(remain, '#') + 1)) END), CASE WHEN INSTR(SUBSTR(remain, INSTR(remain, '#') + 1), ' ') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(remain, INSTR(remain, '#') + 1 + INSTR(SUBSTR(remain, INSTR(remain, '#') + 1), ' ')) ELSE '' END, tweet_date FROM hashtag_cte WHERE INSTR(remain, '#') > 0 ) SELECT hashtag, COUNT(*) AS count FROM hashtag_cte WHERE tweet_date BETWEEN '2024-02-01' AND '2024-02-29' GROUP BY hashtag ORDER BY count DESC, hashtag DESC LIMIT 3;
find-bursty-behavior: WITH posts_in_7_days_cte AS ( SELECT p1.user_id, p1.post_date, COUNT(*) AS sevenday_posts FROM Posts p1 JOIN Posts p2 ON p1.user_id = p2.user_id AND julianday(p2.post_date) - julianday(p1.post_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 6 GROUP BY p1.user_id, p1.post_date ), max_posts_in_7_days_cte AS ( SELECT user_id, MAX(sevenday_posts) AS max_7day_posts FROM posts_in_7_days_cte GROUP BY user_id ), avg_weekly_posts_cte AS ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) / 4.0 AS avg_weekly_posts FROM Posts WHERE post_date BETWEEN '2024-02-01' AND '2024-02-28' GROUP BY user_id ) SELECT m.user_id, m.max_7day_posts, a.avg_weekly_posts FROM max_posts_in_7_days_cte m JOIN avg_weekly_posts_cte a ON m.user_id = a.user_id WHERE m.max_7day_posts >= 2 * a.avg_weekly_posts ORDER BY m.user_id;
find-longest-calls: WITH rank_cte AS ( SELECT contact_id AS id, type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY type ORDER BY duration DESC) AS row_num, printf('%02d:%02d:%02d', duration / 3600, (duration % 3600) / 60, duration % 60) AS duration_formatted FROM Calls ) SELECT c.first_name, r.type, r.duration_formatted FROM rank_cte r JOIN Contacts c ON r.id = c.id WHERE r.row_num <= 3 ORDER BY r.type, r.duration_formatted DESC, c.first_name DESC;
invalid-tweets-ii: SELECT tweet_id FROM Tweets WHERE LENGTH(content) > 140 OR LENGTH(content) - LENGTH(REPLACE(content, '@', '')) > 3 OR LENGTH(content) - LENGTH(REPLACE(content, '#', '')) > 3 ORDER BY tweet_id;
friday-purchase-iii: WITH weeks_cte(week_of_month) AS ( SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 ), memberships_cte(membership) AS ( SELECT 'Premium' UNION ALL SELECT 'VIP' ), friday_purchases_cte AS ( SELECT CAST((CAST(strftime('%d', p.purchase_date) AS INTEGER) - 1) / 7 + 1 AS INTEGER) AS week_of_month, u.membership, SUM(p.amount_spend) AS total_amount FROM Purchases p JOIN Users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE CAST(strftime('%w', p.purchase_date) AS INTEGER) = 5 GROUP BY week_of_month, u.membership ) SELECT w.week_of_month, m.membership, COALESCE(f.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount FROM weeks_cte w CROSS JOIN memberships_cte m LEFT JOIN friday_purchases_cte f ON w.week_of_month = f.week_of_month AND m.membership = f.membership ORDER BY w.week_of_month, m.membership;
server-utilization-time: WITH diff_cte AS ( SELECT (strftime('%s', LEAD(status_time) OVER (PARTITION BY server_id ORDER BY status_time)) - strftime('%s', status_time)) AS diff, session_status FROM Servers ) SELECT CAST(SUM(diff) / 86400.0 AS INTEGER) AS total_uptime_days FROM diff_cte WHERE session_status = 'start';
employee-task-duration-and-concurrent-ta: WITH events_cte AS ( SELECT employee_id, start_time AS event_time, 1 AS delta FROM Tasks UNION ALL SELECT employee_id, end_time, -1 FROM Tasks ), time_points AS ( SELECT DISTINCT employee_id, event_time FROM events_cte ), segments AS ( SELECT employee_id, event_time AS start_time, LEAD(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY employee_id ORDER BY event_time) AS end_time FROM time_points ), segment_counts AS ( SELECT s.employee_id, s.start_time, s.end_time, SUM(e.delta) AS event_count FROM segments s JOIN events_cte e ON s.employee_id = e.employee_id AND e.event_time >= s.start_time AND e.event_time < COALESCE(s.end_time, e.event_time || 'z') WHERE s.end_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.employee_id, s.start_time, s.end_time ), agg AS ( SELECT employee_id, SUM((strftime('%s', end_time) - strftime('%s', start_time)) * event_count) AS total_seconds, MAX(event_count) AS max_concurrent_tasks FROM segment_counts GROUP BY employee_id ) SELECT employee_id, CAST(total_seconds / 3600.0 AS INTEGER) AS total_task_hours, max_concurrent_tasks FROM agg ORDER BY employee_id;
calculate-parking-fees-and-duration: WITH info_cte AS ( SELECT car_id, lot_id, SUM(strftime('%s', exit_time) - strftime('%s', entry_time)) AS duration FROM ParkingTransactions GROUP BY car_id, lot_id ), max_info_cte AS ( SELECT car_id, MAX(duration) AS max_duration FROM info_cte GROUP BY car_id ), max_duration_lot_cte AS ( SELECT a.car_id, a.lot_id AS most_time_lot FROM info_cte a JOIN max_info_cte b ON a.car_id = b.car_id AND a.duration = b.max_duration ), total_cte AS ( SELECT car_id, SUM(fee_paid) AS total_fee_paid, SUM(strftime('%s', exit_time) - strftime('%s', entry_time)) AS total_duration FROM ParkingTransactions GROUP BY car_id ) SELECT t.car_id, t.total_fee_paid, ROUND(t.total_fee_paid * 3600.0 / t.total_duration, 2) AS avg_hourly_fee, m.most_time_lot FROM total_cte t JOIN max_duration_lot_cte m ON t.car_id = m.car_id ORDER BY t.car_id;
second-day-verification: SELECT e.user_id FROM emails e JOIN texts t ON e.email_id = t.email_id WHERE t.signup_action = 'Verified' AND CAST(julianday(date(t.action_date)) - julianday(date(e.signup_date)) AS INTEGER) = 1 ORDER BY e.user_id;
find-top-scoring-students-ii: WITH best_enrollments_cte AS ( SELECT student_id, course_id, MIN(grade) AS grade FROM enrollments GROUP BY student_id, course_id ), major_mandatory_grade_a_count_cte AS ( SELECT s.student_id, s.major, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM best_enrollments_cte e JOIN students s ON e.student_id = s.student_id JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE s.major = c.major AND lower(c.mandatory) = 'yes' AND e.grade = 'A' GROUP BY s.student_id, s.major ), major_mandatory_count_cte AS ( SELECT major, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM courses WHERE lower(mandatory) = 'yes' GROUP BY major ), major_elective_grade_a_or_b_count_cte AS ( SELECT s.student_id, s.major, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM best_enrollments_cte e JOIN students s ON e.student_id = s.student_id JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE s.major = c.major AND lower(c.mandatory) = 'no' AND e.grade <= 'B' GROUP BY s.student_id, s.major ), gpa_cte AS ( SELECT student_id, AVG(GPA) AS gpa FROM enrollments GROUP BY student_id ) SELECT c1.student_id FROM major_mandatory_grade_a_count_cte c1 JOIN major_mandatory_count_cte c2 ON c1.major = c2.major JOIN major_elective_grade_a_or_b_count_cte c3 ON c1.student_id = c3.student_id JOIN gpa_cte c4 ON c1.student_id = c4.student_id WHERE c1.cnt = c2.cnt AND c3.cnt >= 2 AND c4.gpa >= 2.5 ORDER BY c1.student_id;
bitwise-user-permissions-analysis: WITH RECURSIVE bit_and_cte(val, rid) AS ( SELECT permissions, rowid FROM user_permissions WHERE rowid = (SELECT MIN(rowid) FROM user_permissions) UNION ALL SELECT b.val & u.permissions, u.rowid FROM bit_and_cte b JOIN user_permissions u ON u.rowid = (SELECT MIN(rowid) FROM user_permissions WHERE rowid > b.rid) ), bit_or_cte(val, rid) AS ( SELECT permissions, rowid FROM user_permissions WHERE rowid = (SELECT MIN(rowid) FROM user_permissions) UNION ALL SELECT b.val | u.permissions, u.rowid FROM bit_or_cte b JOIN user_permissions u ON u.rowid = (SELECT MIN(rowid) FROM user_permissions WHERE rowid > b.rid) ) SELECT (SELECT val FROM bit_and_cte ORDER BY rid DESC LIMIT 1) AS common_perms, (SELECT val FROM bit_or_cte ORDER BY rid DESC LIMIT 1) AS any_perms;
find-overlapping-shifts-ii: WITH time_cte AS ( SELECT employee_id, start_time AS time FROM EmployeeShifts UNION SELECT employee_id, end_time FROM EmployeeShifts ), segments_cte AS ( SELECT employee_id, time AS start_time, LEAD(time) OVER (PARTITION BY employee_id ORDER BY time) AS end_time FROM time_cte ), counts_cte AS ( SELECT s.employee_id, s.start_time, s.end_time, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM segments_cte s JOIN EmployeeShifts e ON s.employee_id = e.employee_id WHERE s.end_time IS NOT NULL AND s.start_time >= e.start_time AND s.end_time <= e.end_time GROUP BY s.employee_id, s.start_time, s.end_time ) SELECT employee_id, MAX(cnt) AS max_overlapping_shifts, SUM(cnt * (cnt - 1) / 2 * CAST((strftime('%s', end_time) - strftime('%s', start_time)) / 60.0 AS INTEGER)) AS total_overlap_duration FROM counts_cte GROUP BY employee_id ORDER BY employee_id;
longest-team-pass-streak: WITH RECURSIVE edges_cte AS ( SELECT t1.team_name AS team1, t2.team_name AS team2, p.time_stamp FROM Passes p JOIN Teams t1 ON p.pass_from = t1.player_id JOIN Teams t2 ON p.pass_to = t2.player_id ), sorted_edges_cte AS ( SELECT team1, team2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY team1 ORDER BY time_stamp) AS rnk FROM edges_cte ), scores_cte AS ( SELECT team1, team2, rnk, CASE WHEN team1 = team2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS score FROM sorted_edges_cte WHERE rnk = 1 UNION ALL SELECT s.team1, s.team2, s.rnk, CASE WHEN s.team1 = s.team2 THEN sc.score + 1 ELSE 0 END FROM sorted_edges_cte s JOIN scores_cte sc ON s.rnk = sc.rnk + 1 AND s.team1 = sc.team1 ) SELECT team1 AS team_name, MAX(score) AS longest_streak FROM scores_cte GROUP BY team1 HAVING longest_streak > 0 ORDER BY team1;
first-letter-capitalization: WITH RECURSIVE splitted_word_cte(content_id, content_text, word, remain, idx) AS ( SELECT content_id, content_text, CASE WHEN INSTR(content_text, ' ') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(content_text, 1, INSTR(content_text, ' ') - 1) ELSE content_text END, CASE WHEN INSTR(content_text, ' ') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(content_text, INSTR(content_text, ' ') + 1) ELSE '' END, 1 FROM user_content UNION ALL SELECT content_id, content_text, CASE WHEN INSTR(remain, ' ') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(remain, 1, INSTR(remain, ' ') - 1) ELSE remain END, CASE WHEN INSTR(remain, ' ') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(remain, INSTR(remain, ' ') + 1) ELSE '' END, idx + 1 FROM splitted_word_cte WHERE remain != '' ), formatted_word_cte AS ( SELECT content_id, content_text, idx, word, UPPER(SUBSTR(word, 1, 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTR(word, 2)) AS formatted_word FROM splitted_word_cte ) SELECT content_id, content_text AS original_text, GROUP_CONCAT(formatted_word, ' ') AS converted_text FROM formatted_word_cte GROUP BY content_id, content_text ORDER BY content_id;
find-circular-gift-exchange-chains: WITH RECURSIVE cycles_cte(giver_id, receiver_id, gift_value, start) AS ( SELECT giver_id, receiver_id, gift_value, giver_id FROM SecretSanta UNION ALL SELECT s.giver_id, s.receiver_id, s.gift_value, c.start FROM SecretSanta s JOIN cycles_cte c ON s.giver_id = c.receiver_id AND s.giver_id != c.start ), cycle_start_length_value_triples_cte AS ( SELECT start, COUNT(*) AS chain_length, SUM(gift_value) AS total_gift_value FROM cycles_cte GROUP BY start ), unique_cycle_length_value_pairs_cte AS ( SELECT chain_length, total_gift_value FROM cycle_start_length_value_triples_cte GROUP BY chain_length, total_gift_value ) SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY chain_length DESC, total_gift_value DESC) AS chain_id, chain_length, total_gift_value FROM unique_cycle_length_value_pairs_cte;
find-cities-in-each-state-ii: SELECT state, GROUP_CONCAT(city, ', ') AS cities, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(city, 1, 1) = substr(state, 1, 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matching_letter_count FROM cities GROUP BY state HAVING COUNT(city) >= 3 AND matching_letter_count >= 1 ORDER BY matching_letter_count DESC, state;
find-valid-emails: SELECT user_id, email FROM Users WHERE email GLOB '[A-Za-z0-9_]*@[A-Za-z]*.com' ORDER BY user_id;
find-products-with-three-consecutive-dig: SELECT product_id, name FROM products WHERE name GLOB '*[0-9][0-9][0-9]*' AND name NOT GLOB '*[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]*' ORDER BY product_id;
find-invalid-ip-addresses: SELECT ip, COUNT(*) AS invalid_count FROM logs WHERE ip NOT GLOB '[0-9]*.[0-9]*.[0-9]*.[0-9]*' OR ip LIKE '%..%' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ( WITH RECURSIVE octets(oct, rest) AS ( SELECT CAST(SUBSTR(ip || '.', 1, INSTR(ip || '.', '.') - 1) AS INTEGER), SUBSTR(ip || '.', INSTR(ip || '.', '.') + 1) UNION ALL SELECT CAST(SUBSTR(rest, 1, INSTR(rest, '.') - 1) AS INTEGER), SUBSTR(rest, INSTR(rest, '.') + 1) FROM octets WHERE rest != '' ) SELECT 1 FROM octets WHERE oct < 0 OR oct > 255 ) ) GROUP BY ip ORDER BY invalid_count DESC, ip DESC;
